title: Introducing Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, bringing its powerful features to all users to enhance productivity and decision-making.

title: Enhanced File and Media Management
summary: Effortlessly manage, upload, download, and customize the display of all your embedded content directly within the editor for a more powerful and personalized creation experience.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Stay informed about our latest achievements, upcoming features, and long-term plans through our new, interactive public roadmap page.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more seamless and intuitive experience with our enhanced checkboxes, now featuring larger clickable areas, easy drag-and-drop functionality, and a refined look that perfectly matches our modern interface.

title: Seamless Teamwork in Your Editor
summary: Our latest enhancements deliver a significantly smoother and more intuitive collaborative editing experience, making teamwork easier and more productive.

title: Improved Shared Content Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless teamwork as all shared content is now easily discoverable and readily accessible, empowering more effective collaboration with your network.

title: Noeko Goes Global with Multilingual Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for international languages, making our platform truly global.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with maximum control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's exciting journey forward.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map & Collaboration
summary: Explore your knowledge base with unprecedented clarity through dynamic filtering options and seamless collaboration features within your intuitive knowledge map.

title: Refined Search and Saved Collections
summary: Discover unparalleled precision with our new search experience, enabling you to swiftly filter, sort, and save dynamic collections of your knowledge for instant retrieval.

title: Intuitive Content Previews
summary: Discover a more natural way to organize your thoughts with flexible, interactive previews for linked content directly within your notes.

title: Noeko's Premium Release: Control Your Data, Unlock New Features
summary: Experience ultimate control and enhanced capabilities as Noeko officially launches with options for self-hosting and premium features tailored to your needs.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with Expanded Themes
summary: We're launching a major visual upgrade, refining our existing themes and introducing a diverse collection of stunning new styles to personalize your experience.

title: Precise Time-of-Day Greetings
summary: Experience perfectly synchronized greetings that always reflect the accurate time, making your daily interactions smoother and more personal.

title: Quick Tag Cleanup & Management
summary: Efficiently manage your tagged content by removing multiple items directly from the tag view with new bulk actions, saving you valuable time and effort.

title: Expand Your Information Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate a rich variety of content, from dynamic videos and interactive websites to versatile text files, directly into your knowledge base for comprehensive insights.
